title: REQ · The palette is exported as Tailwind colours
summary: Palette colours available as Tailwind utilities
description: Context: tailwind.config.ts L4 extends colors with hsl(var(--x)) tokens only. Desired behavior: palette.ts exports paletteTailwindColors (ramp name -> step 1..6 -> hex) and tailwind.config.ts adds it under colors.pal, giving classes such as bg-pal-wood-3. Expected result: UI can use palette colours via utilities. Why: UI and art must use the same colours.
acceptance_criteria: Given paletteTailwindColors, when read, then every PALETTE colour appears exactly once as a value.
Given tailwind.config, when theme.extend.colors.pal is read, then it equals paletteTailwindColors.
Given tailwind.config, when theme.extend.colors.background is read, then it is still hsl(var(--background)).

preserve: Existing token colours and content globs

technical_constraints: Tailwind stays; palette defined once and reused, not duplicated.
